does_not_do: It does not parse filings or extract financial data; the files are left as EDGAR serves them.
focus_reason: Downloading is half the need; parsing has to come from elsewhere. One release in the year; last commit 2026-02-02.
measured_against: Need: read SEC EDGAR filings and their financial data into structured form.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory and a continuous-integration workflow.
what_it_is: A Python package that downloads filings from SEC EDGAR to disk.
